videos.desc: In a Pixar-style barbershop a client sits with a giant afro and huge beard; the moustached barber trims it all with clippers, comb and scissors, then shows the neat new cut in a hand mirror and the delighted client admires himself.
videos.said: Short on the sides, please. Say no more. Whoa! I look great!

videos.desc: At a white vanity a girl dips a big brush into a round pink blush compact, sweeps it onto her cheeks in front of the mirror while her friend watches, and both admire the fresh pink glow, framing her face with their hands.

A young woman leans close to a bathroom mirror and carefully draws a black winged line along her upper eyelid with an eyeliner pen while a friend watches behind her. She finishes the wing, celebrates, and tidies the edge with a cotton swab, getting a thumbs up.
videos.said: (snaps) Oh, nailed it. (laughs) - No one's flying. (upbeat music)

videos.desc: Close-up of a makeup palette as a brush picks up shimmery gold eyeshadow, then pats and blends it over a woman's eyelid until the whole lid sparkles gold. She then admires the finished golden lids with a friend on camera.
videos.said: Liquid gold. Ooh, look at that.

videos.desc: At a cozy pajama night, a woman spreads thick green clay from a bowl over her friend's face with a spatula. The two sit with matching green face masks; the dried masks crack as one starts laughing and warns the other not to make her laugh.
videos.said: Don't make me laugh. It's cracking!

videos.desc: At a bright vanity by a window, a friend helps a young woman with dots of foundation on her cheek, blending them into her skin with a makeup sponge. The camera shows her evenly covered face turning from side to side, and both smile into the round mirror next to bottles of foundation, saying 'That one gone, so smooth.'

A boy in green pajamas goes through his bathroom routine: he brushes his teeth at the mirror, rinses his mouth, lathers his hands with soap, washes his face, dries off with a white towel and gives a happy thumbs up.

A young woman holds up a pink lip gloss tube, pulls out the applicator wand and paints the glossy pink liquid onto her lips in close-up. She pats them with a finger and shows off the shiny glass-like result, saying it is shiny like glass.

At a lit vanity mirror, a young woman pulls the wand out of a black mascara tube and brushes it onto her lashes with her mouth wide open the whole time, the funny face everyone makes. Her friend watches behind her, she fixes a smudge with a cotton swab and admires her lashes.
videos.said: The face, everyone does it. Hello. (gasps)

videos.desc: A big white enamel basin stands on a wooden stool in a garden and everything happens over it: a woman leans her head down into it, her friend washes her hair above the water, the soapy water collects inside, and at the end a can of clean water is poured over her hair back into the basin.

At a vanity mirror a young woman lifts a pink bob of fake hair off a white mannequin head and pulls it on over her own hair, striking poses. Her friend then claps a curly ginger one onto his shaved head and they both mug for the mirror.
videos.said: Oh! A whole new me! And off it comes!

videos.desc: Selfie video under a grape pergola: a young woman scrunches her forehead to show her temporary frown lines and says hers just vanish, then her white-haired grandmother leans in, points proudly at the deep wrinkles on her own face and jokes that she earned these; both laugh.
videos.said: Mine just vanish. I earned these.

videos.desc: A bright marble barber's shop with lit mirrors and shelves of bottles. A gorilla sits in the barber's chair under a black cape, with an enormous round afro standing out around its head. A ginger cat in a white barber's coat and a red bow tie stands on the arm of the chair and runs a pair of electric clippers up the side of the afro, cutting a clean line into it. Clumps of black hair drop onto the cape. The cat works its way round, then swaps to scissors and trims across the top, and what is left is a squared-off block of hair with a perfectly level top, like a table top on the gorilla's head. The gorilla looks straight ahead, unimpressed, while the cat finishes and gives a small nod of approval.

A make-up studio with a bulb-lit mirror. A woman with a white towel wrapped round her hair sits with her eyes closed; separate stripes of skin-coloured cream have been dabbed on her forehead and cheeks. A hand dabs an orange sponge over them until the stripes disappear into her skin and the tone is even. A red-haired make-up artist then sweeps powder over her cheek with a brush, and in close-up paints her lips with a dark red lipstick. At the end the woman looks up with an even, finished face and red lips.

A woman sits at a lit vanity mirror with hard stripes of pale foundation and dark contour drawn across her cheek and forehead. A makeup artist works over them with an orange sponge, dabbing and pressing until the edges disappear, then goes over the same areas with a soft brush. The harsh lines melt into an even, glowing complexion, and at the end she is shown the finished face in a hand mirror.

In a salon a stylist combs out a client's very long glossy black hair, then weaves a thick braid along the top of her head and down through the length of the hair; at the end the client stands up and swings the hair, which reaches almost to the floor, with the finished braid running over the crown.

Close up, a man's face is covered in thick white shaving foam and he draws a straight razor down his cheek, leaving a clean stripe. In a bathroom mirror he trims his beard with an electric trimmer. In a barbershop a barber shaves his beard line with a straight razor while he sits under a white cape. By a swimming pool a bare forearm with a white stripe of foam is shaved smooth. Finally he sits grinning in the barber chair while four men around him applaud.

A young woman in a cropped brown hoodie and matching sweatpants stands at the wooden barre of a mirrored dance studio, her long hair tied back in a ponytail that swings as she moves. She holds the barre and laughs, turns to face the mirrored wall, then drops to the floor into a low crouch with one leg extended, springs up into a jump with her knees tucked, spins with her back to the mirror, and finishes facing the camera out of breath and smiling.

In a busy restaurant a waiter with a thick black moustache, in a white shirt and dark apron, sets down a glass, then lifts a metal pot high above his head and pours a long thin stream of tea into a small tulip glass on the table without spilling, and finally lowers the pot and looks up.

A young woman with glasses and her blonde hair twisted up into a round knot on top of her head stands reading a paperback in a moving tram, city buildings sliding past the windows. She then sits cross-legged on a park bench in autumn sunshine, the same knot of hair on top, reading and yawning behind her hand. In the last shots she is under a blanket in the dark with a single candle burning beside the open book, eyes wide behind her glasses, then grinning as she reads on.

A young woman in a red dress with a backpack twirls under tiled arches beside a fountain. She then sits close to the camera at a bar counter with a glass of red wine, a plate of thin cured ham and a dish of fried potatoes; her thick dark hair grows in tight rings and springs around her face as she leans in, laughs and drinks. The clip ends on a mosaic rooftop terrace at sunset with her arms thrown open over the city.

A wooden jetty on a turquoise bay at golden hour, with a white sailing boat moored beside it and pine trees on the rocky shore. A laughing young woman with long sandy hair in a navy one-piece swimsuit walks barefoot towards the camera and pulls one strap down off her shoulder, showing a pale stripe where the sun has tanned the skin around it. She laughs, covers her face with her hand and swings a white linen shirt. Rope and a canvas bag lie on the boards, and a friend sits at the end.

In a busy backstage dressing room, a young woman with her hair in a low bun and a black satin robe sits with her eyes closed and her chin raised. A make-up artist's hand paints gold leaf onto her lips and chin with a fine brush, then a second brush comes in. Gold covers her eyelids, the ridge of her nose and her lips. A hairdryer blows flakes of gold into the air. Clothes rails, lit mirrors, a white gown on the wall and other models getting ready fill the room.

A mirror selfie in a bright barber shop with a brick wall and colourful posters. A man in a black barber cape sits in the chair and holds up his phone, looking surprised: one side of his face is shaved clean with a little foam left, while the other side still has a full dark beard. Behind him a young woman barber with a high braided bun, a burgundy top and a black apron mixes shaving foam in a bowl, then picks up a razor and smiles. Hanging bulbs, red chairs and a plant fill the shop.
